name: io.github.matharrismma/concordance
description: Receipts for numbers: deterministic verification of a numeric claim, returned as a re-checkable, content-addressed, signed receipt (COSE_Sign1 in the SCITT shape + an in-toto Statement, logged to Rekor).

environmentVariables.name: CONCORDANCE_ISSUER_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional base64url Ed25519 private key. Without it, receipts are self-attested (content-addressed only); with it they are signed and can be logged to Rekor.
